column2: [intro]
I stood there, at the closed door of happiness
But I found another color, more or less
When everything goes wrong, the best remedy
Is to laugh at yourself, see life with levity
It's a sad song, but I don't care
I find it quite fascinating, sometimes rare
In my quirky tales, we lose our way
Come on, take my hand and let the fleeting stay
I got lost in a maze of socks
Stepped on LEGO, it really shocks!
But instead of complaining, I choose to laugh
For laughter's the best way to handle life's gaffes
It's a sad song, but I don't care
I find it quite fascinating, sometimes rare
In my quirky tales, we lose our way
Come on, take my hand and let the fleeting stay
[ solo ]
So here is my sad song, full of madness
To lighten your burden, even for a night’s gladness
In this sometimes dark world, we need to cheer
And I'll be the singer of joy, ready to bring you near
[outro]
